added: {{app}} added. Choose who can open it under People.
fromContactsEmpty: Apps your contacts share show up here.
goOffline: Go offline: nothing you share stays reachable
needsApp: Sharing a local web app needs the Ghostly browser extension or desktop app.
nobodyYet: Nobody can open it until you pick who.
offDisconnectsChats: Turning this off disconnects every chat
openNeedsApp: Opening a contact's web app needs the Ghostly browser extension or desktop app.
removeText: Contacts you shared it with can no longer open it.

window.blocked: This browser blocks what {{app}} needs to open here: storage for a site inside another. Allow it for this site, or open {{app}} in the Ghostly desktop app or extension.
window.busy: {{app}} has too many pages loading at once on your contact's machine. Try again in a moment.
window.callOn: A call is on. End it to open {{app}}.
window.elsewhere: {{app}} tried to send you somewhere else, outside what your contact shares.
window.label: {{app}}, shared by {{contact}}
window.notAnswering: {{app}} is not answering on your contact's machine. Ask them to check that it is running.
window.offline: Your contact is offline, so {{app}} cannot open now. It opens again here when they are back.
window.owner: {{contact}}'s app, running on their machine. Not Ghostly: never type your recovery words or passwords here.
window.stillOffline: Your contact is still offline, so {{app}} cannot open now. It opens again here when they are back.
window.tooSlow: {{app}} did not answer in time on your contact's machine. Try again in a moment.
window.unguarded: This page of {{app}} cannot be shown here: it keeps Ghostly's protections from running in it. Ask your contact to check it.
window.unreachable: This service is not reachable. Services exist while their ghost is online.
window.unshared: {{app}} is no longer shared with you.
window.upload: A contact's app cannot get files from the browser extension. To send this one, open the app in Ghostly on the web or on the desktop.
